author: thomgxx
quote: Genuine trash. This is not GTA. You're literally forced to be in a relationship? Making certain groups of people invincible? What the actual f*** is wrong with these devs. The entire point of this game is to kill and do whatever you want. It's not real life dude. They're not real people. These guys had a chance to not let their bias shine through in this game. They could have proven everyone wrong. But no. They did the exact opposite. The proved everyone who said this game was going to be GTA by name only correct. Such a shame. Fix the invincible protesters and maybe you'll recover what little bit of reputation you have left. Nothing will make up for the 30 fps though!!
